title: Design a Tic Tac Toe Game
description: Model the board, players, moves, and win detection for 3x3 and extensible boards.

data.text: Design a two-player tic-tac-toe game. Represent the board, enforce alternating turns, detect wins and draws, and support reset.

data.title: Board and Game
Why this design?
data.text: Board is a pure data structure with rules. Game orchestrates turns and win checks. This separation makes it easy to swap in a larger board (4x4, 5x5) or different win conditions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Board owns placement and win detection
Game tracks current player and game end state
CheckWinner checks rows, columns, and both diagonals
Design supports any square board size
data.takeaway: Tic tac toe is a simple state machine with a grid. Keep the board logic inside Board so Game stays clean and testable.
